title: The commit node is refused fail-closed under the shipped autopilot gate, and the refusal is now reportable
intent: Pin sprint 13's most consequential finding, corrected for what sprint 5 and sprint 6 of spec-20260812-pge-real-workload-errors changed about it: under autopilot the gate mechanism is noop, noop grants nothing, and the git-effect node is refused FAIL_CLOSED exactly as before. What is NEW is that the refusal is no longer invisible — success STILL reports true (Option A: deriveRunSuccess is sprint-split based and does not move for a terminal-node refusal that is not a sprint), but PipelineResult.errors now carries the refusal as a PipelineFailure, and two downstream consumers act on it: `bober run` sets process.exitCode 1 and prints a 'Refused:' block naming the failing node and its errorClass (src/cli/commands/run.ts), and the MCP RunManager sets RunState.status to 'failed' and populates .error with a one-line description (src/mcp/run-manager.ts). A caller must still check errors, never success, to see any of this — the finding is corrected, not reversed.

expected.notes: git.commit is ABSENT from the pinned responses and that absence is still the primary assertion: the interpreter refuses to dispatch a git-effect node without a recorded approval, and the noop mechanism records none. What sprint 5 and sprint 6 of spec-20260812-pge-real-workload-errors added is the pinned pipelineResult above: success stays true (Option A — deriveRunSuccess never moves for a terminal-node refusal that is not a sprint) but errors gains exactly one PipelineFailure — nodeId 'commit', errorClass 'FailClosed', branchKey null, and the message the interrupt controller writes at the fail-closed branch (src/pge/runtime/interrupt.ts) naming the checkpoint and the declared effect. Neither the CLI exit code nor the MCP RunState.status is a conformance field collectRunArtifacts collects, so neither is representable as a pinned artifact here; both are documented in this case's intent instead, and are under direct test at src/cli/commands/run.test.ts and src/mcp/run-manager.test.ts (sc-6-1..sc-6-4). A future change that made autopilot commit would produce a git.commit call this case does not pin and fail; a future change that stopped populating errors for this exact refusal would change the pinned pipelineResult and fail this case too.
